units.name: knockback-core
units.note: sourceKnockback.ts cites zz_00300bc_ (chunk_0003.c:8540-8627, launch direction), its atan2->BAM16 helper FUN_800452a0 (chunk_0005.c:2191-2204), and the strength-indexed magnitude selects zz_005ec20_ (chunk_0007.c:5544-5574) / FUN_8005ed38 (chunk_0007.c:5601-5640). TWO EXCLUSIONS, both decompiler-artifact limits of verbatim porting (2026-08-10): (1) zz_00300bc_ passes &local_38 as a vec3 base and reads local_34/local_30 — adjacent PPC stack slots that clang does NOT keep adjacent at -O1 or -O0 (measured: oracle red both ways); needs the export to recover the local as float[3]. (2) FUN_8005ed38's trig helpers zz_0045204_/zz_0045238_ decompile to the (longlong)x * 0x3ff0000000000000 artifact, which no header-only fix can make semantically correct. harness-knockback.mjs keeps the full direction oracle and self-skips it until zz_00300bc_ is exported.

units.name: collision-core
units.note: STRUCTURAL oracle of the three collision hit-pair passes cited by sourceCollision.ts: collision_hit_pair_pass_active_vs_borgs (chunk_0003.c:7026-7164), _active_vs_secondary (7168-7306), _object_lists (7310-7426). SCOPED OUT, with reasons: (1) resolve_hitbox_target_effects_and_damage @0x8002e2a8 (7473-8195) — its 7519-7944 effect-bookkeeping body is unported in TS (TS ports only the delegation tail), so the verbatim body has no oracle, AND it calls zz_00300bc_ unconditionally, which the knockback-core unit already proved verbatim-unportable (local-vec3 stack aliasing); (2) the four hitbox-shape functions zz_002fd7c_/zz_0039f6c_/zz_0030348_/zz_0030490_ — undecompiled/unsurfaced (sourceCollision.ts injects them as hooks); (3) battle_frame_target_action_dispatch — call-order only. The shape quartet + resolver are stubbed IDENTICALLY on both sides (header stubs <-> harness TS hooks + pair log at GC 0x80630000), so the oracle gates the verbatim filter chains, immediate-vs-deferred, sentinel closest-target search, deferred nudge, and delegation order/identity/contact. CORPUS CONSTRAINTS (TS-vs-ROM deltas found 2026-08-10, kept out of the corpus and flagged for TS follow-up): (a) flagsA bit 0x800 skip exists only in pass 1 in the ROM, but TS runPassCore applies it to all passes — 0x800 is generated only for pass-1 actives; (b) pairOwnersAdmissible's per-side owner-link clear is an OR chain in the ROM (ownerFlag==0 || otherFamily==0x0e || linked!=other, chunk_0003.c:7087-7090) but (A||B)&&C in TS — the corpus installs exclusion cells only where both forms agree (unique same-team-borg counterpart). Local verdict 2026-08-10: 20000/20000 pair sequences exact, 28121/32153 post-state exact + 4032 f32-explained, 0 unexplained.
